taste:
Mushy peas have a sweet, earthy flavour and a thick, creamy consistency. The peas are cooked down until soft and smooth, giving this side a very different texture from battered fish or crispy chips. Their green colour adds contrast to the plate, but the main reason to choose them is that combination of gentle sweetness and earthy flavour.

Served steaming hot, they are a traditional chip shop accompaniment rather than a crunchy side. Alongside battered fish, the smooth peas contrast with the crisp coating; with chips, they offer the same change in texture. Choose them if you enjoy soft, comforting sides with a familiar fish and chip character.
